metadata.originalAvailability: Original per-row publication timestamps unavailable; historical observations reconstructed from current source releases.
metadata.availabilityBasis: Games and participation occurred in 2017; current releases lack original per-row publication timestamps. Retrospectively reconstructed prior-season observations, not a draft-day roster.

metrics.players200Plus: Distinct team/player pairs with at least 200 regular-season offensive plus defensive snaps. A descriptive role threshold, not validated player quality.
metrics.positiveSnapPlayers: Distinct team/player pairs with positive offensive or defensive snaps.
metrics.largestPlayerShare: Largest individual scrimmage total divided by the position-group total, not share of team plays.
metrics.totalKnownScrimmageSnaps: Sum of offensive plus defensive player-snaps for all classified position groups, including any specialist scrimmage snaps. This counts player participation, not team plays. All 2017 source positions are classified; unclassified snaps are zero.
metrics.positionGroup: Each team/player is assigned to the position with the largest observed snap-weighted row total. All that team/player contribution is then grouped consistently; position changes are not modeled as separate roles.
metrics.topContributors: Four largest group contributors. Traded players can appear for multiple teams, with only each team contribution counted.
metrics.annualRosterObservation: Latest roster observation during the 2017 season; this does not establish April 2018 membership. A PFR identity can link a different last-observed team after a trade.

limitations: No reconstructed April 2018 roster, free-agent departures, contracts, or roster continuity.
No supported scheme inference; depth-chart formation labels are only Offense, Defense, and Special Teams.
Prior head coaches are derived from 2017 games, not 2018 draft-day appointments.
A small contributor count may reflect healthy entrenched starters rather than roster need.
The 200-snap threshold is a descriptive convention; no empirical optimality is claimed.
Roster joins use exact PFR IDs or unique normalized names and matching team. Unresolved matches remain null.
Original publication times for retrospectively distributed rows are unavailable.
